method_descriptions.ipcw_platt_original: Frozen Stage 3.1 IPCW-Platt probability; no changes
method_descriptions.uniform_20pct_risk_reduction: Label-independent illustrative 20% downscale of all risks
method_descriptions.odds_shift_weighted_prevalence: Retrospective odds shift using IPCW-weighted calibration prevalence and validation prevalence
method_descriptions.odds_shift_unweighted_prevalence: Retrospective odds shift using raw labeled calibration prevalence and validation prevalence
method_descriptions.proportional_mean_matching_stress: Retrospective proportional scaling to force adjusted mean probability equal to observed validation prevalence

interpretation_warning: RETROSPECTIVE/VALIDATION-INFORMED SENSITIVITY ONLY. Target prevalence is derived from the same validation labels used for diagnostics; adjusted calibration scores are NOT a clean held-out calibration assessment and must NOT replace the original IPCW-Platt scores. Odds adjustment assumes a label-prior-shift model which has not been validated for this dataset. All net benefits are conditional model-based expectations under illustrative cost and intervention-effect assumptions, not observed causal treatment effects or actual monetary savings.
